title: Keralam Cabinet decides to dissolve Loka Kerala Sabha, replace it with new mechanism
summary: For establishing alternative mechanism, a Cabinet sub-committee chaired by Chief Minister with Home Minister Ramesh Chennithala, Industries Minister P.K. Kunhalikutty, Health Minister K. Muraleedharan and Water Resources Minister Mons Joseph has been constituted

title: Keralam power crisis: State eyeing additional 150 MW from NPCIL, says CM
summary: Satheesan says this ‘should allow Keralam to take control of’ the power situation

title: Three-language policy case: Centre given more time to mull SC proposal to exempt current Class 6
summary: Chief Justice Kant had said the government could use the time to come up with incentives for the children to embrace the study of a third language in school

title: India’s vast canal network offers a land-free path to solar power
summary: Similar to floating solar, the biggest advantage of canal-top photovoltaics is that they require virtually no additional land, especially as land acquisition for large-scale solar is also becoming increasingly more expensive; in Punjab, the installation of 20 MW of canal-top systems is estimated to have saved nearly 100 acres of land

title: Microplastics detected in soil near Periyar riverbank in Edayar industrial area in Keralam
summary: Tests carried out at School of Environmental Studies, Mahatma Gandhi University, found that the samples contained up to 2,520 microplastic particles per kg

title: Election Commission dissent sparks Opposition call for CEC Gyanesh Kumar’s removal
summary: Two ECs stated that Form 6 — which new voters must fill out to register — was altered to ask if the applicant or their parents/grandparents “exist” on the electoral roll of the last SIR; Opposition parties are asking the Supreme Court to take suo motu cognisance of the report

title: Five crore Indian children still lack access to sanitation service in their schools, says UN report
summary: India is among the 28 out of 62 countries that are on track to achieve universal coverage of basic drinking water in schools by 2030

title: Record savings on medical expenses under Ayushman Bharat: PM Modi
summary: Today, more than 60 crore beneficiaries have access to ₹5 lakh annual health cover making it the largest healthcare scheme in the world, said PM Modi in his X post
